about: The review of each map's exact bytes (docs/decisions/0017-a-map-change-carries-a-review-of-its-bytes.md). tools/check-map-review.py fails any map whose sha256 is not the one recorded here.

exemption.reason: Grandfathered, not reviewed: this map predates the review gate and has never been blind-mapped. examples/faa-part-107/blind-mapping/ reviewed the 2026-01-01 map against the 2026 text; this map was last changed in 5d09898, before those corrections, and nothing compared it with a second reading of the 2020-01-01 text. A blind second mapping is still owed before it is used for the regulation target under #3.
